correctness.rationale: The ordered-rate parameterization q=exp(-lambda_1*t), S_v=(1-q^v)/(1-q) gives an exact quotient derivative. S_r′/S_m′ is a strictly increasing positive multiple of an upper-truncated mean of y^(r-m), hence H=S_m*S_r′/S_m′-S_r increases exactly from 0 to Theta. This proves the iff uniqueness boundary, including equality, for all positive reals. Exact endpoint algebra gives equal shares; the sharp limit r to infinity proves the factor lambda_2/lambda_1; a two-rate logarithmic ratio proves minimality. 19007 code assertions supplement but do not establish the universal proof.

value.rationale: Concentration abundance and compositional read proportion are systematically distinct measurement objects in eDNA studies. A sharp all-rate description of an interior composition peak, potentially concealed by matching early/late compositions, identifies a specific scientifically motivated interpretation hazard; the simple exact calibration criteria and two-class minimality have independent value for sampling design and data interpretation. It is not only a numerical or routine substitute for a known table.
